findings.issue: Unmarked clitic “la” supplies an object pronoun. The object is the noun phrase כל הדבר הגדל, and יביאו has no pronominal suffix.
והיה introduces the following clause (every great matter they will bring). “será toda la palabra grande” makes that noun the predicate of “be” instead of the object of traer.
Hiphil imperative 2ms (command to lighten) is rendered as future indicative “aligerarás” (prediction). Person and causative stem match; mood/force does not.

notes: Juzgar, pueblo, todo tiempo, palabra grande/pequeña, ellos, de sobre ti, and llevarán contigo match the remaining tokens; contigo does not mark the 2fs tag on אִתָּךְ.
